blurb: The Urban Yogi offers Indian massage therapy sessions at a home studio in Surrey, BC, and private sessions and workshops throughout the lower mainland Vancouver area. Services include Indian massage, acupressure, and reflexology aimed at relieving muscle tension, promoting relaxation, and improving circulation. The therapies are based on traditional Indian methods and aim to reduce stress, pain, and muscle soreness.
